newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cr Immobiler issues ultimatum on Foncier loan plan.
newsitem.headline: Cr Immobiler issues ultimatum on Foncier loan plan.

text.p: France's Credit Immobilier said on Tuesday it would abandon plans to take over property loans and some staff of Credit Foncier de France unless the government reaffirmed its commitment to the project by December 15.

Credit Immobilier de France, which is due to take over the property loans portfolio and 1,500 staff of Credit Foncier under a government plan to wind down the bank, said legal threats and a "negative" publicity campaign made the ultimatum necessary.

"Because of the constraints and practical difficulties to which its network is exposed, the Cooperative Council has decided to renounce its undertakings on December 15, unless decisions are taken by then confirming the state's support and which confirm (our) favourable position on financial markets and especially (our) international ratings," cooperatively run Credit Immobilier said in a statement.

The plan for Credit Immobilier to take on the property loans, which brought France's second bond issuer after the state to its knees earlier this year, was part of a "managed wind-down" of Credit Foncier launched by the government in July.
